rembrandt.linePrev: Oh, I wish I could have told him
rembrandt.line: I looked at the Rubens and Rembrandts,
rembrandt.lineNext: I liked the John Singer Sargents.
stanza: I looked at the Rubens and Rembrandts,
I liked the John Singer Sargents.
He told me he liked Turner
Never have I turned since then
No, never have I turned to any other man

partner.line: No, never have I turned to any other man
